ayahs.textArabic: حٰمۤ  ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥā mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Ha. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-kitābil-mubīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER this divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā ja‘alnāhu qur'ānan ‘arabiyyal la‘allakum ta‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: behold, We have caused it to be a discourse in the Arabic tongue, so that you might encompass it with your reason.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهٗ فِيْٓ اُمِّ الْكِتٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيْمٌ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahū fī ummil-kitābi ladainā la‘aliyyun ḥakīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, verily, [originating as it does] in the source, with Us, of all revelation, it is indeed sublime, full of wisdom.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا اَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa naḍribu ‘ankumuż-żikra ṣafḥan an kuntum qaumam musrifīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [O YOU who deny the truth!] Should We, perchance, withdraw this reminder from you altogether, seeing that you are people bent on wasting your own selves?

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَّبِيٍّ فِى الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kam arsalnā min nabiyyin fil-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And how many a prophet did We send to people of olden times!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ya'tīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But never yet came a prophet to them without their deriding him –

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَهْلَكْنَآ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَّمَضٰى مَثَلُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ahlaknā asyadda minhum baṭsyaw wa maḍā maṡalul-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so, [in the end,] We destroyed them [even though they were] of greater might than these: and the [very] image of those people of old became a thing of the past.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَىِٕنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيْزُ الْعَلِيْمُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunnal-‘azīzul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet thus it is [with most people]: if thou ask them, “Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth?” - they will surely answer, “The Almighty, the All-Knowing has created them.”

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī ja‘ala lakumul-arḍa mahdaw wa ja‘ala lakum fīhā subulal la‘allakum tahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who has made the earth a cradle for you, and has provided for you ways [of livelihood] thereon, so that you might follow the right path.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۚ فَاَنْشَرْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażī nazzala minas-samā'i mā'am biqadar(in), fa'ansyarnā bihī baldatam maitā(n), każālika tukhrajūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He it is who sends down, again and again, waters from the sky in due measure: and [as] We raise therewith dead land to life, even thus will you be brought forth [from the dead].

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażī khalaqal-azwāja kullahā wa ja‘ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an‘āmi mā tarkabūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He it is who has created all opposites. And He [it is who] has provided for you all those ships and animals whereon you ride,

ayahs.textArabic: لِتَسْتَوٗا عَلٰى ظُهُوْرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ اِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُوْلُوْا سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Litastawū ‘alā ẓuhūrihī ṡumma tażkurū ni‘mata rabbikum iżastawaitum ‘alaihi wa taqūlū subḥānal-lażī sakhkhara lanā hāżā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: in order that you might gain mastery over them, and that, whenever you have mastered them, you might remember your Sustainer’s blessings and say: “Limitless in His glory is He who has made [all] this subservient to our use - since [but for Him,] we would not have been able to attain to it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّآ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, verily, it is unto Him that we must always turn.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ جُزْءًا ۗاِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُوْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۗ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alū lahū min ‘ibādihī juz'ā(n), innal-insāna lakafūrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND YET, they attribute to Him offspring from among some of the beings created by Him! Verily, most obviously bereft of all gratitude is man!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصْفٰىكُمْ بِالْبَنِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Amittakhażū mimmā yakhluqu banātiw wa aṣfākum bil-banīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or [do you think], perchance, that out of all His creation He has chosen for Himself daughters, and favoured you with sons?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهٗ مُسْوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā busysyira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lir-raḥmāni maṡalan ẓalla wajhuhū muswaddaw wa huwa kaẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: For [thus it is:] if any of them is given the glad tiding of [the birth of] what he so readily attributes to the Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with suppressed anger:

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَمَنْ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِى الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Awamay yunasysya'u fil-ḥilyati wa huwa fil-khiṣāmi gairu mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: “What! [Am I to have a daughter -] one who is to be reared [only] for the sake of ornament?” and thereupon he finds himself torn by a vague inner conflict.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةَ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ عِبٰدُ الرَّحْمٰنِ اِنَاثًا ۗ اَشَهِدُوْا خَلْقَهُمْ ۗسَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alul-malā'ikatal-lażīna hum ‘ibādur raḥmāni ināṡā(n), asyahidū khalqahum, satuktabu syahādatuhum wa yus'alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [yet] they claim that the angels - who in themselves are but beings created by the Most Gracious - are females: [but] did they witness their creation? This false claim of theirs will be recorded, and they will be called to account [for it on Judgment Day]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا لَوْ شَاۤءَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنٰهُمْ ۗمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَخْرُصُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū lau syā'ar-raḥmānu mā ‘abadnāhum, mā lahum biżālika min ‘ilm(in), in hum illā yakhruṣūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet they say, “Had [not] the Most Gracious so willed, we would never have worshipped them!” [But] they cannot have any knowledge of [His having willed] such a thing: they do nothing but guess.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ فَهُمْ بِهٖ مُسْتَمْسِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ātaināhum kitābam min qablihī fahum bihī mustamsikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or have We, perchance, vouchsafed them, before this one, a revelation [to the contrary,] to which they are still holding fast?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلْ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ اٰبَاۤءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Bal qālū innā wajadnā ābā'anā ‘alā ummatiw wa innā ‘alā āṡārihim muhtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but they say, “Behold, We found our forefathers agreed on what to believe - and, verily, it is in their footsteps that we find our guidance!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِيْ قَرْيَةٍ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍۙ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوْهَآ  ۙاِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ اٰبَاۤءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّقْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa każālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatim min nażīr(in), illā qāla mutrafūhā, innā wajadnā ābā'anā ‘alā ummatiw wa innā ‘alā āṡārihim muqtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thus it is: whenever We sent, before thy time, a warner to any community, those of its people who had lost themselves entirely in the pursuit of pleasures would always say, “Behold, we found our forefathers agreed on what to believe - and, verily, it is but in their footsteps that we follow!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قٰلَ اَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاَهْدٰى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ اٰبَاۤءَكُمْۗ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla awalau ji'tukum bi'ahdā mimmā wajattum ‘alaihi ābā'akum, qālū innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Whereupon each prophet] would say, “Why, even though I bring you guidance better than that which you found your forefathers believing in?” - [to which] the others would reply, “Behold, we deny that there is any truth in [what you claim to be] your messages!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fantaqamnā minhum fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mukażżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We inflicted Our retribution on them: and behold what happened in the end to those who gave the lie to the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖٓ اِنَّنِيْ بَرَاۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qāla ibrāhīmu li'abīhi wa qaumihī innanī barā'um mimmā ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND WHEN Abraham spoke to his father and his people, [he had this very truth in mind:] “Verily, far be it from me to worship what you worship!

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْ فَطَرَنِيْ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهْدِيْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Illāl-lażī faṭaranī fa'innahū sayahdīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: None [do I worship] but Him who has brought me into being: and, behold, it is He who will guide me!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً ۢ بَاقِيَةً فِيْ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alahā kalimatam bāqiyatan fī ‘aqibihī la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he uttered this as a word destined to endure among those who would come after him, so that they might [always] return [to it].

ayahs.textArabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ وَاٰبَاۤءَهُمْ حَتّٰى جَاۤءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Bal matta‘tu hā'ulā'i wa ābā'ahum ḥattā jā'ahumul-ḥaqqu wa rasūlum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now [as for those who did come after him,] I allowed them - as [I had allowed] their forebears - to enjoy their lives freely until the truth should come unto them through an apostle who would make all things clear:

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā jā'ahumul-ḥaqqu qālū hāżā siḥruw wa innā bihī kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but now that the truth has come to them, they say, “All this is mere spellbinding eloquence” - and, behold, we deny that there is any truth in it!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū lau lā nuzzila hāżal-qur'ānu ‘alā rajulim minal-qaryataini ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they say, too, “Why was not this Qur’an bestowed from on high on some great man of the two cities?”

ayahs.textArabic: اَهُمْ يَقْسِمُوْنَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَۗ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَّعِيْشَتَهُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۙ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗوَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbik(a), naḥnu qasamnā bainahum ma‘īsyatahum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa rafa‘nā ba‘ḍahum fauqa ba‘ḍin darajātil liyattakhiża ba‘ḍuhum ba‘ḍan sukhriyyā(n), wa raḥmatu rabbika khairum mimmā yajma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But is it they who distribute thy Sustainer’s grace? [Nay, as] it is We who distribute their means of livelihood among them in the life of this world, and raise some of them by degrees above others, to the end that they might avail themselves of one another’s help - [so, too, it is We who bestow gifts of the spirit upon whomever We will]: and this thy Sustainer’s grace is better than all [the worldly wealth] that they may amass.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْلَآ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَّكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمٰنِ لِبُيُوْتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau lā ay yakūnan-nāsu ummataw wāḥidatal laja‘alnā limay yakfuru bir-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufam min fiḍḍatiw wa ma‘ārija ‘alaihā yaẓharūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And were it not that [with the prospect of boundless riches before them] all people would become one [evil] community, We might indeed have provided for those who [now] deny the Most Gracious roofs of silver for their houses, and [silver] stairways whereon to ascend,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِبُيُوْتِهِمْ اَبْوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa libuyūtihim abwābaw wa sururan ‘alaihā yattaki'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [silver] doors for their houses, and [silver] couches whereon to recline,

ayahs.textArabic: وَزُخْرُفًاۗ وَاِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۗوَالْاٰخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa zukhrufā(n), wa in kullu żālika lammā matā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wal-ākhiratu ‘inda rabbika lil-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and gold [beyond count]. Yet all this would have been nothing but a [brief] enjoyment of life in this world - whereas [happiness in] the life to come awaits the God-conscious with thy Sustainer.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ يَّعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهٗ شَيْطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa may ya‘syu ‘an żikrir-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahū syaiṭānan fahuwa lahū qarīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But as for anyone who chooses to remain blind to the remembrance of the Most Gracious, to him We assign an [enduring] evil impulse, to become his other self:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّوْنَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيْلِ وَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahum layaṣuddūnahum ‘anis-sabīli wa yaḥsabūna annahum muhtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereupon, behold, these [evil impulses] bar all such from the path [of truth], making them think that they are guided aright!

ayahs.textArabic: حَتّٰىٓ اِذَا جَاۤءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥattā iżā jā'anā qāla yā laita bainī wa bainaka bu‘dal-masyriqaini fa bi'sal-qarīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: But in the end, when he [who has thus sinned] appears before us [on Judgment Day], he will say [to his other self], “Would that between me and thee there had been the distance of east and west!” for, evil indeed [has proved] that other self!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَنْ يَّنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ اِذْ ظَّلَمْتُمْ اَنَّكُمْ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lay yanfa‘akumul-yauma iẓ ẓalamtum annakum fil-‘ażābi musytarikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: On that Day it will not profit you in the least [to know] that, since you have sinned [together], you are now to share your suffering [as well].

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَاَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوْ تَهْدِى الْعُمْيَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa anta tusmi‘uṣ-ṣumma au tahdil-‘umya  wa man kāna fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: CANST THOU, perchance, [O Muhammad,] make the deaf hear, or show the right way to the blind or to such as are obviously lost in error?

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُّنْتَقِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa immā nażhabanna bika fa innā minhum muntaqimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But whether We do [or do not] take thee away [ere thy message prevails] - verily, We shall inflict Our retribution on them;

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْنٰهُمْ فَاِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُّقْتَدِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Au nuriyannakal-lażī wa‘adnāhum fa'innā ‘alaihim muqtadirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and whether We show thee [or do not show thee in this world] the fulfillment of what We have promised them - verily, We have full power over them!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِيْٓ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيْكَ ۚاِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fastamsik bil-lażī ūḥiya ilaik(a), innaka ‘alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: So hold fast to all that has been revealed to thee: for, behold, thou art on a straight way;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۚوَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahū lażikrul laka wa liqaumik(a), wa saufa tus'alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, verily, this [revelation] shall indeed become [a source of] eminence for thee and thy people: but in time you all will be called to account [for what you have done with it].

ayahs.textArabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُّسُلِنَآ  ۖ اَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعْبَدُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Was'al man arsalnā min qablika mir rusulinā, aja‘alnā min dūnir-raḥmāni ālihatay yu‘badūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet [above all else,] ask any of Our apostles whom We sent forth before thy time whether We have ever allowed that deities other than the Most Gracious be worshipped!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَا۟ىِٕهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّيْ رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad arsalnā mūsā bi'āyātinā ilā fir‘auna wa mala'ihī fa qāla innī rasūlu rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: THUS, INDEED, have We sent Moses with Our messages unto Pharaoh and his great ones; and he said: “Behold, I am an apostle of the Sustainer of all the worlds!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمْ بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'ahum bi'āyātinā iżā hum minhā yaḍḥakūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But as soon as he came before them with Our [miraculous] signs, lo! they derided them,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا نُرِيْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِيَ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ اُخْتِهَاۗ وَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukhtihā, wa akhażnāhum bil-‘ażābi la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: although each sign that We showed them was weigh­tier than the preceding one: and [each time] We took them to task through suffering, so that they might return [to Us].

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū yā ayyuhas-sāḥirud‘u lanā rabbaka bimā ‘ahida ‘indak(a), innanā lamuhtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [every time] they exclaimed: “O thou sorcerer! Pray for us to thy Sustainer on the strength of the covenant [of prophethood] which He has made with thee: for, verily, we shall now follow the right way!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā kasyafnā ‘anhumul-‘ażāba iżā hum yankuṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But whenever We removed the suffering from them, lo! they would break their word.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادٰى فِرْعَوْنُ فِيْ قَوْمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اَلَيْسَ لِيْ مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهٰذِهِ الْاَنْهٰرُ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِيْۚ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādā fir‘aunu fī qaumihī qāla yā qaumi alaisa lī mulku miṣra wa hāżihil-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī, afalā tubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And Pharaoh issued a call to his people, say­ing: “O my people! Does not the dominion over Egypt belong to me, since all these running waters flow at my feet? Can you not, then, see [that I am your lord supreme]?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ هُوَ مَهِيْنٌ ەۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ana khairum min hāżal-lażī huwa mahīn(un), wa lā yakādu yubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Am I not better than this contemptible man who can hardly make his meaning clear?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوْلَآ اُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ اَسْوِرَةٌ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ اَوْ جَاۤءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falau lā ulqiya ‘alaihi aswiratum min żahabin au jā'a ma‘ahul-malā'ikatu muqtarinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And then - why have no golden armlets been bestowed on him? or why have no angels come together with him?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوْهُ ۗاِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fastakhaffa qaumahū fa aṭā‘ūh(u), innahum kānū qauman fāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus he incited his people to levity, and they obeyed him: for, behold, they were people depraved!

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّآ اٰسَفُوْنَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā āsafūnantaqamnā minhum fa agraqnāhum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But when they continued to challenge Us, We inflicted Our retribution on them, and drowned them all:

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلْاٰخِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ja‘alnāhum salafaw wa maṡalal lil-ākhirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so We made them a thing of the past, and an example to those who would come after them.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā ḍuribabnu maryama maṡalan iżā qaumuka minhu yaṣiddūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW WHENEVER [the nature of] the son of Mary is set forth as an example, [O Muhammad,] lo! thy people raise an outcry on this score,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْٓا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ اَمْ هُوَ ۗمَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۗبَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū a'ālihatunā khairun am huw(a), mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalā(n), bal hum qaumun khaṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and say, “Which is better - our deities or he?” [But] it is only in the spirit of dispute that they put this comparison before thee: yea, they are conten­tious folk!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبْدٌ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: In huwa illā ‘abdun an‘amnā ‘alaihi wa ja‘alnāhu maṡalal libanī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [As for Jesus,] he was nothing but [a human being -] a servant [of Ours] whom We had graced [with prophethood], and whom We made an example for the children of Israel.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاۤءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَّلٰۤىِٕكَةً فِى الْاَرْضِ يَخْلُفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau nasyā'u laja‘alnā minkum malā'ikatan fil-arḍi yakhlufūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And had We so willed, [O you who worship angels,] We could indeed have made you into angels succeeding one another on earth!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِۗ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahū la‘ilmul lis-sā‘ati falā tamtarunna bihā wattabi‘ūn(i), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, BEHOLD, this [divine writ] is indeed a means to know [that] the Last Hour [is bound to come]; hence, have no doubt whatever about it, but follow Me: this [alone] is a straight way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā yaṣuddannakumusy-syaiṭān(u), innahū lakum ‘aduwwum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And let not Satan bars you [from it] - for, verily, he is your open foe!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ عِيْسٰى بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِيْ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ فِيْهِۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā jā'a ‘īsā bil-bayyināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥikmati wa li'ubayyina lakum ba‘ḍal-lażī takhtalifūna fīh(i), fattaqullāha wa aṭī‘ūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW WHEN Jesus came [to his people] with all evidence of the truth, he said: “I have now come unto you with wisdom, and to make clear Unto you some of that on which you are at variance: hence, be conscious of God, and pay heed unto me.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُۗ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha huwa rabbī wa rabbukum fa‘budūh(u), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Verily, God is my Sustainer as well as your Sustainer; so worship [none but] Him: this [alone] is a straight way!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۚفَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fakhtalafal-aḥzābu mim bainihim, fawailul lil-lażīna ẓalamūmin ‘ażābi yaumin alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But factions from among those [who came after Jesus] began to hold divergent views: woe, then, unto those who are bent on evildoing - [woe] for the suffering [that will befall them] on a grie­vous Day!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hal yanẓurūna illas-sā‘ata an ta'tiyahum bagtataw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: ARE THEY [who are lost in sin] but waiting for the Last Hour - [waiting] that it come upon them of a sudden, without their being aware [of its approach]?

ayahs.textArabic: اَلْاَخِلَّاۤءُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍۢ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۗ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-akhillā'u yauma'iżim ba‘ḍuhum liba‘ḍin ‘aduwwun illal-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: On that Day, [erstwhile] friends will be foes unto one another - [all] save the God-conscious.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰعِبَادِ لَاخَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَآ اَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ‘ibādi lā khaufun ‘alaikumul-yauma wa lā antum taḥzanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God will say:] “O you servants of Mine! No fear need you have today, and neither shall you grieve –

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوْا مُسْلِمِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna āmanū bi'āyātinā wa kānū muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [O you] who have attained to faith in Our messages and have surrendered your own selves unto Us!

ayahs.textArabic: اُدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ اَنْتُمْ وَاَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Udkhulul-jannata antum wa azwājukum tuḥbarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Enter paradise, you and your spouses, with happiness blest!”

ayahs.textArabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ ۚوَفِيْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيْهِ الْاَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْاَعْيُنُ ۚوَاَنْتُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yuṭāfu ‘alaihim biṣiḥāfim min żahabiw wa akwāb(in), wa fīhā mā tasytahīhil-anfusu wa talażżul-a‘yun(u), wa antum fīhā khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And there] they will be waited upon with trays and goblets of gold; and there will be found all that the souls might desire, and [all that] the eyes might delight in. And therein shall you abide, [O you who believe:]

ayahs.textArabic: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِيْٓ اُوْرِثْتُمُوْهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tilkal-jannatul-latī ūriṡtumūhā bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for such will be the paradise which you shall have inherited by virtue of your past deeds:

ayahs.textArabic: لَكُمْ فِيْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيْرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lakum fīhā fākihatun kaṡīratum minhā ta'kulūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: fruits [of those deeds] shall you have in abundance, [and] thereof shall you partake!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِيْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-mujrimīna fī ‘ażābi jahannama khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] behold, they who are lost in sin shall abide in the suffering of hell:

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yufattaru ‘anhum wa hum fīhi mublisūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: it will not be lightened for them; and therein they will be lost in hopeless despair.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ẓalamnāhum wa lākin kānū humuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And it is not We who will be doing wrong unto them, but it is they who will have wronged them­selves.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادَوْا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَۗ قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ مّٰكِثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādau yā māliku liyaqḍi ‘alainā rabbuk(a), qāla innakum mākiṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will cry: “O thou [angel] who rulest [over hell]! Let thy Sustainer put an end to us!” - whereupon] he will reply: “Verily, you must live on [in this state]

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنٰكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqqi wa lākinna akṡarakum lil-ḥaqqi kārihūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: INDEED, [O you sinners,] We have conveyed the truth unto you; but most of you abhor the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ اَبْرَمُوْٓا اَمْرًا فَاِنَّا مُبْرِمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Am abramū amran fa innā mubrimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why - can they [who deny the truth ever] determine what [the truth] should be?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوٰىهُمْ ۗ بَلٰى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasma‘u sirrahum wa najwāhum, balā wa rusulunā ladaihim yaktubūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they, perchance, think that We do not hear their hidden thoughts and their secret confabulations? Yea, indeed, [We do,] and Our heavenly forces are with them, recording [all].

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ وَلَدٌ  ۖفَاَنَا۠ اَوَّلُ الْعٰبِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul in kāna lir-raḥmāni walad(un), fa ana awwalul-‘ābidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say [O Prophet]: “If the Most Gracious [truly] had a son, I would be the first to worship him!”

ayahs.textArabic: سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Subḥāna rabbis-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbil-‘arsyi ‘ammā yaṣifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Utterly remote, in His glory, is the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth - the Sustainer, in almigh­tiness enthroned from all that they may attribute to Him by way of definition!

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوْضُوْا وَيَلْعَبُوْا حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِيْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa żarhum yakhūḍū wa yal‘abū ḥattā yulāqū yaumahumul-lażī yū‘adūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But leave them to indulge in idle talk and play [with words] until they face that [Judgment] Day of theirs which they have been promised:

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اِلٰهٌ وَّ فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلٰهٌ ۗوَهُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa huwal-lażī fis-samā'i ilāhuw wa fil-arḍi ilāh(un), wa huwal-ḥakīmul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: for [then they will come to know that] it is He [alone] who is God in heaven and God on earth, and [that] He alone is truly wise, all-knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚوَعِنْدَهٗ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِۚ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tabārakal-lażī lahū mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā, wa ‘indahū ‘ilmus-sā‘ah(ti), wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And hallowed be He unto whom the dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them belongs, and with whom the knowledge of the Last Hour rests, and unto whom you all shall be brought back!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā yamlikul-lażīna yad‘ūna min dūnihisy-syafā‘ata illā man syahida bil-ḥaqqi wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And those [beings] whom some invoke beside God have it not in their power to intercede [on Judgment Day] for any but such as have [in their lifetime] borne witness to the truth, and have been aware [that God is one and unique].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَىِٕنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunnallāhu fa annā yu'fakūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now if thou ask those [who worship any being other than God] as to who it is that has created them, they are sure to answer, “God.” How perverted, then, are their minds!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيْلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْنَۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qīlihī yā rabbi inna hā'ulā'i qaumul lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But God has full knowledge of the true be­liever] and of his [despairing] cry: “O my Sustainer! Verily, these are people who will not believe!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلٰمٌۗ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Faṣfaḥ ‘anhum wa qul salām(un), fa saufa ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet bear thou with them, and say, “Peace [be upon you]!” - for in time they will come to know [the truth].
